strict_arbitrage.claim: A contractual payoff inequality executable at synchronized observed bid/ask and size after all costs
strict_arbitrage.american_contract_rule: European parity is not an unconditional American equality; bound dividends, early exercise, assignment, borrow and funding over all permitted exercise paths

repricing.claim: A probabilistic future price or relative-value effect; classify losses and hedge basis explicitly

financing_events.rationale: Announcement dissemination, next-session digestion for after-hours filings, and short financing-repricing persistence

network_counterparty.rationale: Immediate counterparty read-through, one-week propagation, and one-month relationship repricing

maturity_pressure.rationale: Financing response, monthly credit reassessment, and quarterly maturity/rollover pressure

repricing.equity_input: Independent underlying market prices; option vendor underlying marks alone are insufficient
repricing.options_input: Timestamped quotes and contract definitions with bid/ask/size, expiry, strike, right, multiplier and deliverable
repricing.futures_role: Index and rate exposure hedges, never a company-specific exact contract match

development.fit_rule: Fit thresholds, normalization, universe decisions and hedge ratios using only each fold's strictly prior matured labels
development.purge_rule: Remove training events whose label information interval touches validation; split counterparty/event clusters together
development.embargo_rule: Reserve 63 trading sessions between any training label end and validation entry, the largest frozen session horizon; 30-minute labels use timestamp intervals too
development.matured_labels: Require observed label end before fit cutoff; exclude right-censored labels

holdout.required_audit: Inventory prior 2026 queries, purchases, exploratory results, manual choices and model access before opening validation
holdout.if_consumed: Treat consumed 2026 periods as development. Register a new prospective holdout beginning after freeze, including delayed label maturation; do not relabel consumed history as OOS
holdout.prospective_start_rule: First untouched trading session after documented final strategy freeze and access-control audit

trial_register.selection_rule: Use development folds only; report multiple-testing-adjusted uncertainty, cluster resampling and failed/abandoned trials

execution.entry: First executable quote after public timestamp plus stated latency; after-hours events enter next eligible session
execution.fills: Buy ask and sell bid with executable size limits; no midpoint fills as primary evidence
execution.decision_rule: Report net-return, drawdown, capacity and capital frontier; do not optimize to a retrospectively preferred personal drawdown target

acquisition.unknown_submission: Hold funds and reconcile provider job; no automatic retry
acquisition.dataset_policy: Discover actual availability and quote quality. Exchange-only equity cannot be represented as consolidated NBBO
acquisition.manifest_policy: Nonzero records, size/SHA-256 verified files, measured coverage and independent quality audits required before research readiness
